title: Rav Chanan

paragraphs: In [Kiddushin 39a](https://www.sefaria.org/Kiddushin.39a.11-12), Rav Chanan and Rav Anan were walking along the road. They saw a man sowing seeds together. One said to the other, “Come, Master, let us excommunicate him,” etc. It is known that Rav Anan was Shmuel’s student.[^1]

notes.text: In the linked passage the two sages speak to each other. The text leaves the speakers unnamed in each exchange. [Heilprin](https://www.girsology.com/seder-hadorot.html?entry=1426&lang=en) gives both exchanges about the different plantings.
